ensemble.rule: Ship the round-2 ranker as an optional 'worth a look' ranker only if, on test-v2 (full view): (1) its PR-AUC 95% repository-bootstrap interval lies entirely above the intervals of the kestrix-scan rules and of the bag-of-words baseline (non-overlapping), AND (2) its pair accuracy is at least 0.25, where pair accuracy is the share of vulnerable/patched pairs with the vulnerable version at or above and the patched version below the validation-chosen threshold ('correct' in the C6 reports: 0.322 dev, 0.147 test, 0.071 extension for the C6 teacher). Otherwise it is not shipped.
